assessment.summary: A fitness practitioner performs a body wave plank exercise sequence.

centralIdea.text: Core control and strength can be demonstrated through rhythmic body wave plank variations.

contentMechanic.text: Rhythmic execution of an unconventional movement to capture attention within a standard fitness frame.

visualExecution.text: Low-angle side shot tracking physical undulating motion in a gym setting.

adaptationTemplate.text: Demonstrate a highly visual, advanced variation of a common movement to drive interest.

observations.description: Practitioner starts in low forearm plank and initiates a rhythmic spinal wave movement.
Practitioner continues performing continuous body waves to demonstrate core flexibility.
Practitioner pushes up from forearm plank to high plank position and holds.

evidenceChains.subject: fitness practitioner
evidenceChains.beforeState: Low forearm plank beginning a wave pattern

assessment.summary: A practitioner shows a plank technique correction from setup through a visible result.

centralIdea.text: Correcting plank alignment produces a visibly stronger and more stable technique.

contentMechanic.text: Show incorrect technique, demonstrate the correction, and reveal the corrected form.

visualExecution.text: A clear side-by-side progression from incorrect to corrected plank alignment.

observations.description: The practitioner's hips sag and shoulders sit behind the wrists in a visibly incorrect plank.
The practitioner actively tucks the pelvis and stacks the shoulders over the wrists to correct the plank.
The practitioner holds a straight, aligned plank with the corrected technique visible.

evidenceChains.subject: plank technique
evidenceChains.beforeState: Incorrect plank alignment with sagging hips
evidenceChains.afterState: Straight plank alignment held after correction
